metadata.description: R2-069 Ablation Matrix - Diagnostic analysis of component information content without production score changes
metadata.objective: Understand diagnostic view of component availability and information content; NOT permission to change production score
metadata.dataUniverse: BACKTEST_UNIVERSE (6 validated BIST symbols: THYAO, AKBNK, ASELS, BIMAS, TUPRS, GARAN)
metadata.dataSource: Yahoo Finance historical OHLCV (1D timeframe); point-in-time computation only
metadata.importantDisclaimer: Ablation analysis DIAGNOSTIC ONLY - does not recompute production signals or change weights. Creating a second scoring engine or optimizing production weights is FORBIDDEN per R2-069 #18.

financial.analysisStatus: AVAILABLE - RSI14 proxy from historical close prices; NOT fundamental data
financial.notes: RSI14 is TECHNICAL_PROXY, not fundamentals; financialQuality.minScore=50 threshold; 53 timestamps unavailable due to insufficient data or RSI14 <= 50; financial component uses RSI14 as proxy score

technical.analysisStatus: AVAILABLE - SMA20/SMA9 from historical OHLCV; point-in-time safe
technical.notes: SMA50 unavailable for early 2023 (needs 50 candles); SMA20/SMA9 available for all 142 evaluated observations; point-in-time safe

confluence.analysisStatus: AVAILABLE - SMA20 vs SMA9 comparison; point-in-time safe
confluence.notes: confluence.minScore=55; 53 timestamps unavailable due to missing SMA data; confluence compares SMA20 and SMA9 at T only

smartMoney.analysisStatus: DATA_GAP - No historical smart money data from Yahoo Finance 1D OHLCV
smartMoney.notes: Smart money = UNAVAILABLE historically; hardcoded defaults REMOVED per R2-068A; absence reported as DATA_GAP, NOT as negative factor; smartMoneyWeight=20 configured but contributes 0 when data unavailable

marketStructure.analysisStatus: AVAILABLE - trend, support/resistance from historical OHLCV; point-in-time safe
marketStructure.notes: 53 timestamps unavailable; marketStructureWeight=15 remains configured but contributes 0 when data unavailable; trend from historical data <= T only

componentInformationContent.financial: RSI14 proxy from historical close prices; point-in-time safe but coverage-limited (50% eliminated by RSI14 > 50 candidate filter; additional timestamps have RSI14 <= 50 below threshold)
componentInformationContent.technical: SMA20/SMA9 from historical OHLCV; point-in-time safe; SMA50 requires 50 candles (unavailable for early 2023); the technical component is the largest single contributor to opportunity scores when available
componentInformationContent.confluence: SMA20 vs SMA9 comparison from historical OHLCV; point-in-time safe; provides trend confirmation within the opportunity engine
componentInformationContent.smartMoney: NO HISTORICAL DATA - complete data gap; absence reported as DATA_GAP, not as negative factor or zero-quality smart money; the complete lack of historical smart money data is the critical finding
componentInformationContent.marketStructure: trend, support/resistance from historical OHLCV; point-in-time safe; 53 of 142 timestamps unavailable due to insufficient data depth for full analysis

keyPrinciple: configuredWeight (20) !== availableContribution (0 when unavailable); the 5 component weights remain configured but only available components contribute to the total opportunity score; unavailable components are explicitly documented rather than fabricated or converted to zero

ablationAnalysisNotImplemented.reason: Cannot safely recompute production scores without reproducing scoring logic; creating a second scoring engine is FORBIDDEN per R2-069 #18; documenting component availability and information content instead
ablationAnalysisNotImplemented.verdict: NOT_IMPLEMENTED - ablation can only document component availability and status, not recompute production signals with optimized weights
